news.title: Trump reveals millions of dollars' worth of share deals in big tech and AI
news.summary: Stock in major firms such as Microsoft, Nvidia and SpaceX was bought and sold on behalf of the US president.

news.title: McDonald's CEO expects high inflation, flat traffic are not going away for restaurant industry
news.summary: McDonald's CEO Chris Kempczinski said that he expects that high inflation and flat traffic will continue to weigh on the restaurant industry.
